evidence.title: Accessibility Has Failed: Try Generative UI = Individualized UX

name: Accessibility Has Failed: Try Generative UI = Individualized UX
summary: Essay arguing that 30 years of traditional accessibility work failed and that generative UI can generate an interface per user.
description: A Jakob Nielsen article from February 2024 arguing that accessibility standards have not made computers usable for disabled users, and proposing generative UI as the fix: first-generation designs frozen at ship time, then second-generation UIs generated fresh at runtime and optimized for each person. It also covers old users (75+) and low-literacy users as groups current methods can help, and compares the screen-reader path with AI-generated auditory interfaces.
contains: argues accessibility has failed as a way to make computers usable for disabled users
proposes second-generation generative UI: an interface generated fresh per user at runtime
contrasts the screen-reader path with AI-generated auditory interfaces
covers old users and low-literacy users as groups current approaches can help
